why: Tier-2 runtime perf (Manager 26a 19:11Z: diagnose the claude_desk cost after #29500). The claude_desk builder built a new Database() on every call (~42/tick), and Database() runs create_tables() (~58 CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS + commit) on construction. MEASURED (tick_cost 19:23Z, 41 ticks since the 18:18Z restart): 1,722 calls, mean 118.7 ms, max 3,090.6 ms (= the 3 s busy_timeout), 4.98 s/tick, the largest builder. Not caused by #29500's memo (that read was never memoised; the memo removes config + queue reads only). Tests: the new test fails on the old code (10 constructions vs 1) and passes; 866 tests across every claude_desk suite pass. Gates this adds or changes: none.
